messages:
Noah: Throwing out an idea 1: boardgame + mocktail mini-evening at the office kitchen next Wed? BYO snack, we can do a tiny tournament for Codenames / Sushi Go. :game_die::cocktail:
Ivy: Love it. What time were you thinking?
Noah: Thinking 6:00pm so folks can pop by after wrap-up.
Sam: 6pm works. I'd bring Sushi Go and a small prize (donut voucher?).
Rina: I'm in. I can bring mixers for mocktails (simple citrus + ginger).
Ivy: Heads-up: kitchen table seats ~8. ops-bot: Reminder: food in common areas needs to follow shared-space guidelines. See https://intranet/redwood/office-guidelines
ops-bot: Note: If >10 attendees, please notify Facilities for extra seating. Link: https://intranet/redwood/facilities-request
Noah: Good call. Let's cap at 12 and rotate games if needed. I'll make a simple RSVP post.
Sam: I'll bring a small bluetooth speaker and a soft playlist. No loud EDM pls :sweat_smile:
Ivy: Also adding a quick poll: "Competitive bracket" vs "Casual tables"  react with :trophy: or :relaxed:
Rina: :relaxed: for me. I like casual.
Noah: :trophy: from me, small tournament could be fun.
Ivy: I'll set up the RSVP form and mark kitchen booking.
ops-bot: Event placeholder created: "Boardgames & Mocktails  Kitchen" on company calendar for 2024-06-12 18:00. Facilities request pending if >10.
Sam: I can manage small cash for the donut prize and chips if people chip in.
Rina: I'll bring napkins and a sanitizer bottle.
Noah: Perfect. Tentative: Wed 6pm, kitchen, BYO snacks, mocktails provided by Rina, casual/competitive split based on votes. RSVP in the event. See y'all then! :boardgame:
